headline: US Omits South Africa from Published G20 Summit Participant List
summary: South Africa was omitted from the United States' published list of participating economies for the upcoming G20 Leaders' Summit hosted by Donald Trump, while Poland was included.
why: South Africa is the sole African permanent member of the G20; diplomatic exclusions risk affecting trade relations and international capital flow agreements.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Diplomatic exclusion creates geopolitical friction and policy uncertainty for trade.
